user.title: Add a Delta faucet
user.description: The faucet must already connect to the MQTT broker Home Assistant uses. Enter its Wi-Fi MAC address.

error.invalid_device_id: Enter a 12-digit MAC address, such as 60:A4:23:00:00:01.

abort.already_configured: This faucet is already set up.

data_description.presence_topic: Topic filter where the broker announces the faucet connecting and disconnecting. The last topic level must be connected or disconnected. Leave empty if your broker has none.

unknown_device.message: That device is not a loaded Local Delta faucet.

dispense_out_of_range.message: {ml} mL is outside the allowed range of {min}-{max} mL.

dispense.name: Dispense
dispense.description: Run a measured amount of water.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Publish a raw command to the faucet, for exploring its protocol. The faucet matches the text literally.
